title: Filing an appeal to the Supreme Court

content.scenario: A consumer in India has received an order from the National Commission, and they want to appeal it to the Supreme Court. The consumer has prepared to file an appeal to the Supreme Court within thirty days from the date of the order.
content.outcome: The Supreme Court will consider the appeal and make a decision based on the facts and law.
